command: llvm-mc -triple=aarch64 -filetype=obj A64-P6-adrp-lo12-pair.s -o out.o && ld.lld --image-base=0 -Ttext=0 -o out.elf out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.elf out.bin
notes: Input places the pair at 0xff8 and `blob` at 0x1008 (`adrp x0, blob` / `add x0, x0, :lo12:blob`), so page(blob) - page(adrp) = 0x1000 and the low 12 bits of blob are 8. The bytes are taken after `ld.lld` resolved both relocations; before linking, llvm-mc emits zeros plus `R_AARCH64_ADR_PREL_PG_HI21` at 0xff8 and `R_AARCH64_ADD_ABS_LO12_NC` at 0xffc (verified with `llvm-readobj -r`), which is the same two-site shape the plan's `pair_group` describes. The emitted words are `b0000000` (adrp, imm21 = 1; immlo occupies bits 30:29, so 1 is `0x20000000`, not `0x20`) and `91002000`.
source: Arm MRS ADRP_only_pcreladdr (immhi 5+19, immlo 29+2) and ADD_64_addsub_imm (imm12 10+12)
